summary: A note from SRI-ARC on how the NIC Journal would use FTP for mail delivery and submission. SRI first planned to hide parameters in the username field of MLFL, but the Network Mail Meeting preferred changing FTP so that parameters are stated explicitly. It describes what the NIC wanted.

eli5.summary: A library said how it wanted to receive and send messages through the file-sending program and agreed to change the rules to make that clean.
